description: 斯堪的纳维亚防御 B01 — 即时反制中心：1...d5直接挑战白方e4

intro.popup_en:
Counterattack the Center, Lesson 1
The Scandinavian Defense challenges White's center immediately with 1...d5. Is this the right moment to counterattack, and how can Black remain active afterward?
intro.popup:
反制中心第1课

斯堪的纳维亚防御！
黑方第一手就反制中心

1...d5 直接挑战e4

反制的核心问题：
现在反制时机对吗？
反制后如何保持优势？

outro.popup_en: The first counterattack pattern: challenge the center on move one, keep the queen active on a5, and use piece activity to compensate for development time. Before counterattacking, ask whether the move disrupts the opponent's rhythm and whether your pieces have enough active squares.
outro.popup:
斯堪的纳维亚总结

反制中心的第一模式：
① 选择时机：第一手即反制
② 后的活跃：Qa5机动
③ 棋子活跃度补偿发展落后

反制前问自己：
① 反制能打乱对方节奏吗？
② 我的棋子有足够活跃空间吗？

moves.popup_en: e4 occupies the center.
moves.popup: e4 占中心

moves.popup_en: ...d5! Black immediately challenges White's central control. This is the most direct form of counterplay.
moves.popup:
d5！即时反制！
黑方直接挑战白方的中心控制
这是最直接的反制形式

moves.popup_en: exd5 captures Black's central pawn.
moves.popup: exd5 吃兵

moves.popup_en: ...Qxd5 recaptures with the queen. It looks risky to bring the queen out early, but the queen can remain active and gain tempi if White attacks it carelessly.
moves.popup:
Qxd5 后出动
看似冒险，实则灵活

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops with tempo by attacking the queen.
moves.popup: Nc3 攻击后

moves.popup_en: ...Qa5! The queen retreats to an active square and stays flexible.
moves.popup:
Qa5！后退至a5
灵活机动，保持活跃

moves.popup_en: d4 reinforces White's central space.
moves.popup: d4 巩固中心

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops a knight.
moves.popup: Nf6 发展马

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops and increases pressure on d4.
moves.popup: Nf3 发展马，攻击d4

moves.popup_en: ...Bf5 develops the bishop and contests the center.
moves.popup: Bf5 象出动，争夺中心

moves.popup_en: Ne5! White occupies a key central outpost.
moves.popup: Ne5！马占中心要点

moves.popup_en: ...c6 supports b5 and prepares Black's counterplay.
moves.popup: c6 防守b5，准备反击

moves.popup_en: Bc4 develops the bishop actively.
moves.popup: Bc4 发展象

moves.popup_en: ...e6 reinforces Black's structure.
moves.popup: e6 稳固结构

moves.popup_en: Bg5! White increases pressure on Black's position.
moves.popup: Bg5 施压！

moves.popup_en: ...Bb4 counter-pins White's knight.
moves.popup: Bb4 反钉白马

moves.popup_en: O-O! White castles, securing the king and activating the rook.
moves.popup:
O-O！白方王翼易位
安全落地，激活车

moves.popup_en: ...Bxc3! Black exchanges the bishop for the knight and damages White's pawn structure.
moves.popup:
Bxc3！黑象吃c3马
破坏白方兵形

moves.popup_en: bxc3 recaptures, leaving White with doubled pawns as a structural weakness.
moves.popup:
bxc3 兵吃回
出现双叠兵弱点

moves.popup_en: ...Qxc3! Black's queen captures the pawn and exploits White's doubled-pawn weakness.
moves.popup:
Qxc3！黑后夺子！
抓住叠兵弱点，主动反制

moves.popup_en: Re1 activates White's rook on the e-file and creates a threat against Black's queen.
moves.popup:
Re1 车激活e路
盯住黑后，形成威胁

moves.popup_en: ...Nbd7 develops and prepares to defend while keeping counterplay options.
moves.popup:
Nbd7 马发展
为防守和反击做准备

moves.popup_en: Nxd7 exchanges the knight, following White's active Ne5 outpost.
moves.popup:
Nxd7 白马吃d7
Ne5跳出后的强力兑换

moves.popup_en: ...Nxd7 recaptures and simplifies the position for both sides.
moves.popup:
Nxd7 黑马回吃
局面简化，双方重组

moves.popup_en: Bb3 retreats while maintaining control of d5.
moves.popup:
Bb3 象后撤
保持对d5格的控制

moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king and enters the middlegame.
moves.popup:
O-O！黑方易位
王安全，进入中盘

moves.popup_en: Re3 transfers the rook laterally, preparing to swing toward g3 or h3 for an attack.
moves.popup:
Re3 车横向转移
准备向g3/h3调动攻击

moves.popup_en: ...Qa5! Black's queen repositions while remaining active and pressuring White.
moves.popup:
Qa5！黑后转移
继续保持活跃，施压白方

moves.popup_en: Rg3! The rook swings to g3 and targets g7, creating kingside threats.
moves.popup:
Rg3！车跳g3
瞄准g7，形成王翼威胁

moves.popup_en: ...Rae8! Black occupies the e-file and coordinates the rooks to counter White's threats.
moves.popup:
Rae8！车占e路
反制白方车的威胁，双车联动
